<div class="card-body">
'''Kashyyyk''' is a [[Light]] [[Location]] ([[System]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">キャッシーク</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここには自分のウーキーと密輸屋を配備コスト－2で配備できる。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここで戦闘運命数を引くためには合計で6以上の能力値が必要。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Kashyyyk-SWCA-67693.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Kashyyyk.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' English says those cards deploy -2 here.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Kashyyyk]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
